name: Violaine
source:
Princess Violaine is the last surviving member of the vampire clan that ruled the kingdom in the past. She's waiting in her crypt for her prince charming to wake her up from her slumber with a drop of his blood...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1806280/Leap_of_Love__Dark_Princesses/]Steam[/url]]
